questions.question: When the Israelites spoke against God and Moses in the wilderness, what did the LORD send among them?
After the Israelites admitted they had sinned by speaking against the LORD, what did they want Moses to do?

answers.text: Ask the LORD to take the snakes away
Build a wall around the camp

questions.question: While the Israelites complained out in the wilderness, what did they say they had none of?
The LORD told Moses how Israelites bitten by venomous snakes could live. What did they have to do?

answers.text: Look at the snake on the pole
Touch the snake on the pole
